## Read in Downloaded GEO counts:

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

# List all subjects by finding unique prefixes in the filenames
file_list <- list.files(path ="../../GSE223109_RAW", pattern = ".*\\.mtx")  # Get only matrix files
subject_ids <- gsub("matrix.mtx", "", file_list)  # Extract subject IDs

```

```{r}
setwd("../../GSE223109_RAW/")
# Initialize list to store Seurat objects
seurat_list <- list()

for (subject in subject_ids) {
  # Read files for the subject
  counts <- ReadMtx(mtx = paste0(subject, "matrix.mtx"),
                    features = paste0(subject, "features.tsv"),
                    cells = paste0(subject, "barcodes.tsv"))
  
  # Create a Seurat object and store it in the list
  seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = subject)
  
  # Calculate mitochondrial gene percentage
  seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^mt-")  # Human: "^MT-", Mouse: "^mt-"
  
  # Apply QC filters (850-7800 features & <13% mitochondrial genes)
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, nFeature_RNA > 850 & nFeature_RNA < 7800 & percent.mt < 13)
  
  # Normalize using SCTransform
  # seurat_obj <- SCTransform(seurat_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  
  # Store the processed Seurat object
  seurat_list[[subject]] <- seurat_obj
  
}

# Merge all Seurat objects
merged_seurat <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], y = seurat_list[-1], add.cell.ids = subject_ids)


```

Take TauFisher clustering:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
cell_assignments = openxlsx::read.xlsx("~/Downloads/41467_2024_48041_MOESM11_ESM (1).xlsx", sheet = "SuppFig4") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cellnames, delim = "_", names = c("barcode", "suffix"), cols_remove = F) %>%
  unite("match_me", 1:2, remove = F)

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(merged_seurat) , "ZT(\\d+)R(\\d+)_([A-Z]+-1)$")

zt_nums <- matches[, 2]
r_nums <- matches[, 3]
barcode <- matches[,4]

merged_seurat$ZT = zt_nums
merged_seurat$Rep = r_nums

seurat_cells = paste(zt_nums, barcode, sep = "_")

#Are all cells listed in the supp also in my data?
stopifnot(all(cell_assignments$match_me %in% seurat_cells))

#which cells are in my data, not in supp (we expect the "muscle and endothelial cells" arn't here)
# which(!(seurat_cells %in% cell_assignments$match_me))

merged_seurat$seurat_clusters = cell_assignments$celltype[match(seurat_cells, cell_assignments$match_me)]

```

## Now do Methods of Moments analysis (ORPHEUS)

## Immune cells

```{r}
tmp = Orpheus::extract_clstr_prep_input(merged_seurat, "Immune cells")
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "_ZT(\\d+)R(\\d+)$")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
Rep = as.numeric(matches[,3])
ZT_full = (Rep-1)*24+ZT 

immune_pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT_full, pb_mat)
immune_var_cycling = var_cycling(ZT_full, var_mat, pb_mat)

immune_JTK = var_cycling_JTK(ZT_full, var_mat, pb_mat, out_file_circ = "input_12hr.txt", out_file_mean = "input_24hr.txt", out_file_pb = "input_pb.txt",out_dir = "output/")

immune_doub_cyclers_JTK = immune_JTK[[1]]
immune_fund_cycling_JTK = immune_JTK[[2]]
immune_pb_cyclers_JTK = immune_JTK[[3]] %>% mutate(acrophase_bulk = acrophase_bulk*pi/12)

immune_var_cycling_JTK = merge(immune_doub_cyclers_JTK, immune_fund_cycling_JTK , by = "Gene_Symbols", all = TRUE) %>% mutate(double_freq_acrophase =double_freq_acrophase*pi/12 ) %>% mutate(fund_acro = fund_acro *pi/12)


merge(immune_var_cycling, immune_var_cycling_JTK, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("_cos","_JTK" )) %>%
   filter(double_freq_p_statistic_cos < 0.05 & double_freq_p_statistic_JTK < 0.05)%>%
 ggplot()+
   geom_point(aes((as.numeric(double_freq_acrophase_cos)) %% pi,as.numeric(double_freq_acrophase_JTK)))

merge(immune_pb_cycling, immune_pb_cyclers_JTK, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("_cos","_JTK" )) %>%
   filter(p_statistic_cos < 0.05 & p_statistic_JTK < 0.05)%>%
 ggplot()+
   geom_point(aes((as.numeric(acrophase_bulk_cos)),as.numeric(acrophase_bulk_JTK)))+ylim(c(0,2*pi))+xlim(c(0,2*pi))

immune_phi = Orpheus::calc_phi(ZT_full, pb_cycling_results = immune_pb_cycling, var_cycling_results = immune_var_cycling, var_p_thr = 1, expected_acrodiff_thr = 1)

immune_phi_JTK = Orpheus::calc_phi(ZT_full, pb_cycling_results = immune_pb_cyclers_JTK, var_cycling_results = immune_var_cycling_JTK, var_p_thr = .1, expected_acrodiff_thr = 3/12*pi)

# Orpheus::plot_rhythms(ZT_full, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, plot_me = c("Alox5ap"))
```

## Fibroblasts

```{r}
tmp = Orpheus::extract_clstr_prep_input(merged_seurat, "Fibroblasts")
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "_ZT(\\d+)R(\\d+)$")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
Rep = as.numeric(matches[,3])
ZT_full = (Rep-1)*24+ZT 

fibro_pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT_full, pb_mat)
#Get info to run var_cycling_fix_acro, where phases ARE fixed
all(rownames(pb_mat) == fibro_pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols)
phase_pb = fibro_pb_cycling %>% select(acrophase_bulk) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric

var_cyclers = var_cycling(ZT_full, var_mat, pb_mat, phase_pb)
#Run cosinor regression on variance data, where phases are fixed.
var_cyclers_fixed = var_cycling_fix_acro(ZT_full, var_mat, pb_mat, phase_pb)

plot(-log(as.numeric(var_cyclers_fixed$double_freq_p_statistic)), -log(as.numeric(var_cyclers$double_freq_p_statistic)))

#### cosinor results 1 ###
input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(fibro_pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols") %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.2) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC,  everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC > full_model_AIC)

  # Calculate phi parameters
phi_cos = input_cos %>%
  apply(., 1, function(row) {
    Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
  }) %>%
  t %>%
  as.data.frame
colnames(phi_cos) = c("G_pred", "Ac_pred", "theta", "phi")
print(paste0("cosinor fixed acro: ", sum(!is.nan(phi_cos$phi)), "/",nrow(input_cos), " phi's not nan"  ))

phi = calc_phi(ZT_full, fibro_pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.2, bulk_amp_thr = 0.5)


plot_df = merge(input_cos, phi_cos, by = 0)

theta = 1
# Prepare data for the line
x_line_values <- seq(0, max(plot_df$amplitude_bulk), by = 0.1)
# y_line_values <- -x_line_values^2 * (exp(1)^9 - 1 - theta) / (2*exp(1)^9)
# y_lines_values2 <- -(theta/2)*x_line_values^2
# y_line_values = -.5*exp(-2^2)*x_line_values^2*(exp(2^2)-theta - 1)
y_line_lb <- -(theta/2)*x_line_values^2
y_line_ub <- .5*x_line_values^2
line_data <- data.frame(x = x_line_values, y1 = y_line_lb, y2 = y_line_ub)

# Create the ggplot
library(ggplot2)
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_df,
    aes(x = amplitude_bulk, y = double_freq_amplitude)
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = line_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y1),
    color = "blue", 
    linewidth = 1   
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = line_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y2),
    color = "blue", 
    linewidth = 1   
  ) +
  coord_cartesian() +
  labs(
    x = "Amplitude bulk",
    y = "Double Frequency Amplitude (input$double_freq_amplitude)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", na.value = "black", limits = c(-.1, 1))


#####cosinor method 2#### 
input_cos_fix = var_cyclers_fixed %>% 
     left_join(fibro_pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols") %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC,  everything()) %>%

print(paste0("cosinor fixed acro: ", sum(!is.nan(phi_cos_fix$phi)), "/",nrow(input_cos_fix), " phi's not nan"  ))

phi = calc_phi(ZT, fibro_pb_cycling, var_cyclers_fixed, cycling_p_thr = 0.1, bulk_amp_thr = 0.5)

output_cos_fix = merge(phi_cos_fix, input_cos_fix, by = 0)

theta = 1
# Prepare data for the line
```

## Comparison

```{r}
df_long = merge(fibro_pb_cycling, immune_pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("_fibro", "_immune")) %>%   mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
  filter(p_statistic_fibro<0.05 & p_statistic_immune < 0.05)%>%
pivot_longer(cols = c(amplitude_bulk_fibro, amplitude_bulk_immune), names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "pb_amp")



# Violin plot
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = cell_type, y = pb_amp)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "= PB amp Fibro vs Immune", x = "Cell Type", y = "pb_amp")+ylim(0, 1)
```
